builder_location: vault only (sealed_vault/sealed_builder.py, chmod 600): the builder source embeds the hand-authored case constants, so the repo must never contain it; builder_sha256 pins the exact artifact for vault-side verification
gold_access: scorer opens gold only after outputs are complete; runner never reads author gold
repo_contents: metadata only: this manifest (n, groups, counts, hashes, notes); no cases, no gold, no builder source
separation_note: soft separation on a single shared machine: vault readable by root/main agent by policy only; access logged in vault/access_log.jsonl; if the main agent reads the vault before freeze, the bank must be renamed extra-dev and a new sealed built
